|translation='''Title:''' Still Brave at This Late Hour<ref name="photo" />

'''Card text:''' Use when [[Grand Moff Tarkin|Tarkin]] and a Rebel with ability &gt; 2 participate in the same battle. You may draw one additional battle destiny (two additional destiny if the Rebel is [[Leia Organa|Princess Leia]]).<ref name="photo" />

'''Lore:''' “You gave up the information easily. Dantooine is too far away to serve as an example, but never mind. Soon we shall destroy your Rebel friends.”<ref name="photo" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title describes continued bravery rather than charm. Both game texts require Tarkin and a Rebel with ability &gt; 2 in the same battle and give one additional battle destiny, or two for Leia. The Japanese lore says the information was given up easily and promises to destroy the Rebel friends. The English says “You're far too trusting” and “We will deal with your Rebel friends soon enough.”<ref name="photo" /><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Premiere-D-charmingtothelast.gif|Charming To The Last original English printed face]].</ref>
